user_holds_ghybr_shares.meaning: user holds gHYBR shares obtained by depositing HYBR via GovernanceHYBR.deposit, with funds locked in the shared veNFT

full_exit_withdraw_succeeds.meaning: the legitimate gHYBR holder's full-exit GovernanceHYBR.withdraw call completes without reverting, so the user can withdraw their locked HYBR

withdrawal_reverted.meaning: the GovernanceHYBR.withdraw call reverts (propagated from VotingEscrow.multiSplit) and the user cannot exit their position

assumptions: The full-exit withdraw is performed by a legitimate gHYBR holder, not an unauthorized caller.
The zero split leg arises from the user's own full exit (remainingAmount zero) or fee rounding to zero, not from an external attacker.

unresolved.description: Report does not resolve whether the zero leg is remainingAmount or feeAmount in the observed case; both are described as possible, so the exact zero-valued split element is not fixed.

limitations: The plan formalizes only the legitimate_users_cannot_withdraw impact; the separate withdrawal_reverts impact is not covered here.
The specific zero split element (remainingAmount vs feeAmount) is left symbolic; the completion obligation is stated at the withdraw-call outcome level.
